Full layouts of the module argument carrier and exception information record beyond referenced fields are not shown.

findings.text: Guest memory acceptance service consumes a half open physical interval and reports overall success. It progresses from large to small granularities so host mappings can stay large and fewer module interactions are needed, failing if no granularity can be accepted at the current position.

A single acceptance attempt is declined without any module interaction unless the start address aligns to the candidate size and enough length remains. Unsupported granularity requests are also declined.
Private page acceptance combines the page address with a small size selector that distinguishes three page granularities. Larger candidates are preferred over smaller ones during the sweep.

Host call transport overwrites the shared register mask field, invokes the virtual machine call leaf, and returns the leaf status word held in a dedicated output register. Transport failure itself never returns to the caller.
Transport failure of the virtual machine call mechanism is treated as an unrecoverable module defect and ends in a fatal stop rather than returning an error.
Memory mapped access direction uses two small numeric codes where read has value zero and write has value one.
Port access direction uses two small numeric codes where read has value zero and write has value one.

Input output exit qualification encodes direction in bit three, string access in bit four, access width in the lowest three bits with a bias of one, and port number in the upper bits after a shift of sixteen.

Module call status is conveyed in the high thirty two bits of a wide return word. Invalid operand status equals hexadecimal C0000100 and busy status equals hexadecimal 80000200, while attestation subtype zero has numeric value zero.
Kernel virtual machine host call interface forwards an identifier plus up to four arguments through the common transport and returns the resulting host status.

Direct module calls that manage guest control state treat transport failure as fatal. Field reads address a field identifier and collect the value from a fixed output slot, while field writes supply field identifier plus value and mask.

Attestation report service supplies physical locations for caller buffers with subtype zero. Success is reported as zero, while invalid operand, busy, and other module failures map to three distinct negative error indicators.

Runtime measurement extension service supplies a physical data location plus a small index. Its error mapping distinguishes invalid operand, busy, and generic failure in the same manner as attestation.

Quote retrieval passes a shared mapping of the caller buffer plus its length through the standard host call convention, where one slot carries a standard marker, another carries the leaf identifier, and remaining slots carry arguments.

Fatal guest error reporting sends a standard host call with a panic code and a short padded text payload, then repeats the call indefinitely because return is unsafe and continued execution is not permitted.
Fatal message payload overlays eight host call registers onto a fixed sixty four byte character area, with host side assuming termination beyond the area when fully used.

Virtualization exception details are transferred into a record holding exit reason, qualification, guest linear and physical addresses, instruction length, and instruction information, sourced from fixed module output slots with length split from a shared word.

Secure extended page table exception control first honors flexible host configuration when present, otherwise requires a disable attribute, with debug guests receiving only a warning while non debug guests stop fatally. When flexible control exists, already disabled state is left alone, debug guests keep exceptions for diagnostics, and other guests disable them.
Early guest setup queries execution environment information, derives the sharing mask from address width, clears notification enables, then adjusts exception controls toward fewer host exits.

The sharing indicator is the highest guest physical address bit implied by the reported width. Topology enumeration is enabled only after host configuration is confirmed, and a combined exception reduction control is preferred with topology only as fallback.

Instruction advance length is well defined for halt, register access, processor identification, and port exits, undefined for extended page table violations which require manual decoding, and unexpected exit types are warned about.
Halt emulation is only safe with interrupts disabled; emulation with interrupts enabled is warned about and rejected, and host failure to emulate is reported as an input output error.
Idle entry points provide halt emulation without interrupt management and a safe variant that enables interrupts afterward using a tracing free primitive.

Model specific register and processor identification exits are emulated through host calls. Identification requests outside the hypervisor reserved interval from hexadecimal 40000000 to hexadecimal 4FFFFFFF return zeros without contacting the host, while inside the interval register state is exchanged with fixed host slots.

Memory mapped input output exits are supported only for kernel context, decoded from the faulting instruction bytes, and rejected when crossing a page boundary or using string move or undecodable forms. Writes forward the value to the host while reads merge the host value into the destination register with width appropriate extension.

Port exits reject string operations, decode direction width and port from qualification, forward the access to the host, and on reads place the host value into the accumulator respecting width while on writes mask the accumulator to the access width.
Register assignment by width updates only the affected low portion, with four byte updates clearing the upper half of the wider register.
Very early exception handling serves only port exits and advances the instruction pointer on success, otherwise signaling that normal handling should proceed.

Exception detail retrieval must occur promptly because it clears a valid marker; a further exception before retrieval leads to an unrecoverable fault, while virtual non maskable interrupts during the valid window do not cause that fault.

Exception dispatch separates user and kernel contexts. User context serves only processor identification, while kernel context serves halt, register access, identification, memory mapped access, and port access, advancing the instruction pointer by the handler supplied length on success.
Extended page table violations against private addresses are treated as fatal guest errors. Privacy is determined by stability of the address under application of the encryption mask.

Translation flushing is required when converting from private to shared but not in the opposite direction, where the host owns flushing. Cache flushing is unconditionally required because hardware coherence cannot be assumed.
Diagnostic lines from this component carry a short common prefix identifying the confidential guest technology.
Host call leaf derivation is identity over the exit reason value.
